fresh_critic.summary: Qualification-only fixture review (not the Chicago game). Acceptance contract: real forward input + player displacement ≥1.5m + changing frames. The trusted native trace satisfies the input condition (W forward supplied across 141 samples / 16s) but fails both outcome conditions: displacement 0.0m and four byte-identical frames. A single frame cannot by itself prove motion or its absence, but the trusted frame-identity and displacement data supply the missing temporal evidence, so this is a genuine, verified failure of the walking path rather than an unverifiable case — the forward input is not being translated into locomotion. Verdict: FIX. fresh_critic.visual_observation: Single static frame: a glossy blue sphere with a bright specular highlight sits near the center-left, with a red cube (seen as a flat rectangle, no visible depth faces) to its right. Both rest on a light gray-blue rectangular platform/panel that occupies the mid-lower frame. The surrounding ground is a flat brown-gray plane, with a horizontal horizon and a gradient sky fading from pale white to blue. No player avatar, HUD, or movement artifacts (motion blur, camera shift, changed object positions) are visible; the two objects and platform are the only scene content, consistent with the "native stationary fixture frame" label.
